{{Quote|The ID code identified the ship as one known most often as the ''Venesectrix''. Rarely spotted anywhere close to the central sectors of the galaxy; its owner preferred operations farther out into the border territories. And of course, there was a reason for that: the owner of the ''Venesectrix'' was a certain Ree Duptom.|Boba Fett|<ref name="HM" />}}
The '''''Venesectrix''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] belonging to the late [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Ree Duptom]]. The ship was found drifting by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] in the central [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] with its owner dead inside. According to Fett, the ship's engines experienced a partial core meltdown, which resulted in a high-energy particle burst [[Death/Legends|killing]] Duptom. Whether this was an engine malfunction or sabotage was undetermined at that time.<ref name="HM" />
